title: pofshader
description: `pofshader` loads and controls a GLSL shader, with its first inlet enabling or disabling playback via `play 0/1`. Use `load SHADER` to load matching `.vert` and `.frag` files, or provide both filenames explicitly; uniforms can then be set with typed messages such as `f`, `2f`, `3f`, `4f`, and `tex`.
